integrity: The combined-model rules, branching-process threshold statement, numerical non-monotonicity, and the source’s explicit statement that a proof of threshold-curve monotonicity was missing were read in the primary full text. The proof uses a common graphical construction and an analytic earliest-discrepant-birth argument; the included finite checker is only a sanity test and is not treated as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the level-one extinction/survival threshold in the instantaneous recursive homogeneous-mixing model. It does not assert value monotonicity, strictness, differentiability, uniqueness of arbitrary level sets, finite-population stochastic ordering after susceptible depletion, or validity under tracing delays or one-step tracing.
title: The combined manual–digital contact-tracing threshold region is coordinatewise monotone
